rationale: Both retained independent finals reach needs_revision, and I concur. There is no substantive disagreement: the verifier additionally identifies unsupported receipt-based elapsed-day semantics, while the primary highlights repeated-invocation coverage and conditional repeated-source approval. All remain unresolved. The frozen source initializes status to spaces and sets NEW only at zero; a missing deadline classification rule is plausible but not established. Neither the source nor clause establishes OK/LATE as the required interface. Clause 65(8) requires an actual CKYCR update within seven days of receiving updated customer information, which status classification cannot demonstrate. The proposal disclaims full compliance, but the case's intended behavior still overclaims what its evidence supports.
scope_judgment: Allowlisted lines 22–26 are blank lines inside 2000-CHECK-SLA before the zero-day NEW rule. They provide a plausible local insertion locus for classification while preserving that existing override. The scope contains no transmission, update-completion tracking, or provenance connecting elapsed days to receipt of customer information. It therefore cannot substantiate the stated compliance outcome.
intended_fixture_judgment: The eight-day LATE fixture and seven-day OK fixture cover both sides of the inclusive seven-day classification boundary. One day provides another positive timely input, and zero exercises the existing NEW rule. However, OK/LATE expectations and receipt-based input semantics lack supporting evidence. These fixtures observe only status, not registry update completion or receipt and completion timestamps. A justified limited classification objective and interface evidence are required before acceptance.
regression_fixture_judgment: The zero-day NEW fixture is source-grounded and useful for preserving the existing override. One-day and seven-day OK expectations describe new intended behavior, not preservation: fresh frozen-source executions leave status blank for both. Relabel them accordingly. The single zero-day observation and PROCEDURE DIVISION literal assertion do not establish comprehensive preservation outside the locus. Repeated paragraph invocation with a preexisting status is not covered; the frozen paragraph leaves that status unchanged for positive inputs.
capability_judgment: The reported GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 batch capability fits this standalone program and direct paragraph fixtures. It reports case_checks_executed as false, so no compilation or fixture pass is established for a candidate. Proof is limited to finite execution observations; the backend lacks complete semantic-equivalence proof and other stated static capabilities. Successful status fixtures would not prove CKYCR transmission or regulatory compliance.
duplicate_source_judgment: The stated preselection before detector results provides a defensible conditional justification for repeated-source retention. Both reviewers agree on preserving dependent-group reporting, disclosing case and distinct-bundle counts, and avoiding independent-case interval claims. The primary explicitly preserves the all-reviewer approval condition; the verifier notes that this packet cannot independently verify preselection or other group members. These qualifications are compatible and remain applicable. Required approvals have not been achieved, and dependence through source_bundle_group must remain disclosed.
unresolved_issues: The intended regulatory-compliance claim exceeds what the status-only source and fixtures can demonstrate.
The OK/LATE interface and connection between elapsed-day input and receipt of updated customer information require evidence.
The one-day and seven-day fixtures must be classified as intended new behavior rather than frozen-source regressions.
Finite regression coverage does not establish general outside-locus equivalence or address repeated invocation with preexisting status.
No candidate compilation or case execution results are supplied.
Repeated-source retention requires all reviewer approvals and continued disclosure of dependence; preselection and other group members are not independently verified by this packet.
